scope.comparison: Compute MEASURED on one container class (Modal A100 + 8 cores + 64 GiB); outcomes SYNTHETIC (atlas/simulation.py at 79a7792); FWER and power are ESTIMATE. Seconds: in-container study and scoring wall time; load, outcome prep, adjacency and warm-up apart in start-up; the cutoff and rate summary not timed. The lab and batched lanes run different test and calibration procedures, not equal statistical work. Parity: X sha256 on every shared study; z in full for the A100 lane, through per-study maxT for the hybrid; the fused lane: same features, same top score (X sha256 on every shared study, maxT through each study)
scope.calibration: Lab: 1,000 within-strata shuffles in every study. Biopsy Scan lanes: one threshold from 1,000 independent calibration nulls; evaluating those studies is timed inside each lane, computing the cutoff from them is not
